spatial.subfield_mapping_notes: The ingested 3D asset represents the macroscopic unsegmented left hippocampus (Cornu Ammonis CA1-CA4 + dentate gyrus within one contiguous boundary). Distinct internal subfield parcellation boundaries are not resolved in this macroscopic surface mesh and will be integrated during subsequent subfield segmentation phases.

boundaries.superior: Temporal horn of lateral ventricle (ventral floor) and amygdaloid complex (anterosuperior)
boundaries.inferior: Subiculum and parahippocampal gyrus (separated by hippocampal fissure)
boundaries.anterior: Amygdaloid complex (separated by uncal recess of temporal horn)
boundaries.posterior: Splenium of corpus callosum, tapering into subsplenial gyrus / indusium griseum
boundaries.medial: Ambient cistern, wing of ambient cistern, and midbrain crus cerebri
boundaries.lateral: Collateral eminence of temporal horn of lateral ventricle

relationships.notes: Dentate gyrus interlocks with cornu ammonis, receiving perforant path inputs and projecting mossy fibers to CA3.
Transition zone between 3-layered archicortex of CA1 and 6-layered parahippocampal neocortex.
Located immediately anterosuperior to the hippocampal head.
Hippocampus proper is archicortex (3 layers) and does not receive a Brodmann number. Area 28 (Entorhinal cortex) is an adjacent paralimbic area providing primary cortical input via perforant path.
